# Catalog, Inventory & Detail Page Requirements Checklist: Product Management & Product Detail Page

**Purpose**: Peer-review validation of requirements completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability across catalog management, inventory auditing, and order coordination
**Created**: 2026-11-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` workflow based on feature context and user requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all required and optional attributes for creating and updating a product (`name`, `categorySlug`, `price`, `originalPrice`, `badge`, `badgeType`, `image`, `gallery`, `description`, `features`, `specs`, `initialStockQuantity`, `isActive`) explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §3.1–3.2]
- [ ] CHK002 Are mandatory audit fields for every manual stock adjustment (`productId`, `previousQuantity`, `quantityChange`, `newQuantity`, `reason`, `adjustedBy`, `createdAt`) completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Data Model §1.2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all required UI elements on the customer product detail page (`/products/:id`)—including gallery, pricing, stock/discontinued badge, quantity selector, add-to-cart, copy-link share, features, specs, and related items—explicitly listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, US1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the semantic distinction between physical stock availability (`inStock`) and commercial visibility (`isActive`) unambiguously defined across all state combinations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the exact formula and rounding rule for `discountPercent` (`Math.round((originalPrice - price) * 100.0 / originalPrice)` when `originalPrice > price`, `0` otherwise) specified without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the exact behavior when a visitor accesses the direct URL (`/products/:id`) of a hidden/discontinued product (`isActive = false`) clearly defined (page loads details, displays `"Sản phẩm đã ngừng kinh doanh"`, disables purchasing)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, US1 Scenario 4]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do order cancellation restock rules in `spec.md` (`FR-014`) and `data-model.md` (§2) align with `001-order-management` so that physical `stockQuantity` is restored while a discontinued product's `isActive = false` state is preserved? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, US4 Scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK008 Are product stock mutation rules consistent in prohibiting direct `stockQuantity` overwrites in `PUT /api/v1/admin/products/{id}` so that all post-creation stock changes require a reason via `POST /api/v1/admin/products/{id}/stock-adjustments`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §3.2]
- [ ] CHK009 Do public category count rules (`GET /api/v1/categories`) and public product listing rules (`GET /api/v1/products`, `/bestsellers`) consistently exclude `isActive = false` items? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Contracts §1.1–1.3]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality & Measurability

- [ ] CHK010 Are all six success criteria (`SC-001` through `SC-006`) phrased as measurable, verifiable outcomes without leaking framework-internal implementation details? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK011 Can historical order immutability (`SC-005`, `US4 Scenario 1`) be objectively verified after an administrator edits a product's name, image, or selling price? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US4, SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are validation failure scenarios specified for invalid pricing (`price <= 0`, `originalPrice < price`) and invalid stock adjustments (blank `reason`, `quantityChange == 0`, or resulting `newQuantity < 0`)? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-006, FR-009, FR-010]
- [ ] CHK013 Are cart and checkout guard requirements defined when a product already inside a guest or authenticated user's cart is subsequently discontinued (`isActive = false`) or depleted (`stockQuantity = 0`)? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §FR-013, US4 Scenarios 2–3]
- [ ] CHK014 Is fallback behavior defined when a product has no secondary gallery URLs (defaulting `gallery` to `[image]`) or when a guest cart containing a discontinued item is synchronized on login (`POST /api/v1/cart/sync`)? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements (Security, Concurrency & Schema Evolution)

- [ ] CHK015 Are backend role-based access control (`ROLE_ADMIN`) requirements explicitly mandated for all `/api/v1/admin/products/**` and `/api/v1/admin/categories/**` endpoints (`401` for unauthenticated, `403` for `ROLE_USER`)? [Security, Spec §FR-015, Constitution Principle II]
- [ ] CHK016 Is database row-level pessimistic locking (`PESSIMISTIC_WRITE` via `ProductRepository.findByIdWithLock`) required for manual stock adjustments to prevent race conditions with concurrent order creation and cancellation? [Concurrency, Spec §FR-010, Edge Cases, Constitution Principle III]
- [ ] CHK017 Are database schema changes restricted to a new append-only Flyway migration (`V7`) without modifying historical migrations `V1`–`V6`? [Schema Evolution, Plan §Constitution Check, Constitution Principle V]
- [ ] CHK018 Are out-of-scope boundaries (Voucher Wallet / Ví ưu đãi, physical file upload to cloud storage, multi-SKU product variants) explicitly documented to prevent scope creep? [Scope Boundary, Spec §Clarifications, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
